title: Substitute
text: Let $$w=1+2x$$, so $$x=\frac{w-1}{2}$$ and $$dx=\frac{1}{2} dw$$. The limits become $$w=1$$ and $$w=9$$.

title: Evaluate
text: The integral becomes $$\frac{1}{4}$$ times the integral of $$w^{\frac{1}{2}}-w^{\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)}$$ from $$1$$ to $$9$$, which is $$\frac{1}{4} \left(12+\frac{4}{3}\right)$$.
